subject: Stephen Skinner (b. 1948, living person) — map of everything the repo already covers that his work touches
method: Repo-internal search only (no external research in this slice). Every row cites the exact file:line where the overlap lives and the shipped page + anchor that the Skinner page should link to.

anchorMechanics.libraryCards: assets/js/app/library.js:94 — every practitioner card gets id `x-<slug(name)>`; practice headings get `p-<slug(practice)>` (library.js:144). Stable, safe deep-link targets.
anchorMechanics.greatworks: assets/js/app/greatworks.js:139,165 — works get `gw-w-<workId>`, author sections `gw-a-<authorId>`. Stable targets.
anchorMechanics.opgraph: assets/js/app/opgraph.js:273-303 — the URL hash on pages/opgraph.html is a FILTER serialization (c=,t=,g=,l=,w=,harm=,na=), NOT a node anchor. Node anchors `#ogn-<id>` exist only in the DOM after render; a URL like opgraph.html#ogn-gw:ars-notoria is harmless (decodeFilter ignores it) but scroll-to-node at load is not guaranteed. Link the page plainly and NAME the record.
anchorMechanics.confluenceAtlas: pages/confluence.html#<slug>. Exactly 200 slugs exist in assets/js/core/data/confluence.js. Relevant live slugs: picatrix, event-picatrix-translation, splendor-solis, event-dee-angelic-conversations, de-occulta-philosophia, monas-hieroglyphica.

Living-person discipline: every repo record touching Skinner already conforms (positions with named holders, cite-only, verified fields); the Skinner page must keep that bar, and the two existing characterisations ('historian-practitioner', 'respected' tier) are the site's own editorial tiers, sourced at card level — reuse by link, not by restatement.
